integrity: The all-k result is supported by an analytic Taylor expansion and exact polynomial sign identities; finite symbolic/numerical replay is corroborative rather than a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is local in v and theta around the distinguished \(q=3\) threshold.
For \(k\ge5\) it does not establish that the emerging local maxima are global and does not prove the global uniqueness conjecture.
title: Quartic critical point and reciprocal pitchfork in the three-state Potts tree maximizer
